sections.title: Expressing time spans at work
sections.content: You know *-tól/-től ... -ig* (A1, Unit 31) and *-ban/-ben* (A1); this screen only uses them for work. To describe your workday routine, use *-tól/-től ... -ig* (from ... to ...), *-ban/-ben* with *munkaidő* (*munkaidőben* = during working hours), and the verb *túlórázik* (to work overtime).

items.spanish: Általában kilenctől ötig dolgozom az irodában.
items.english: I usually work from nine to five at the office.
During work hours I don't usually deal with private matters.

items.spanish: Ha sok a határidős feladat, gyakran túlórázom.
items.english: When there are many deadline tasks, I often work overtime.

sections.content: *túlórázik* is an *-ik* verb: *én túlórázom*, *te túlórázol*, *ő túlórázik*, *mi túlórázunk*.
